objective: Implement fourteen bounded Jev accessibility-intelligence capabilities around deterministic measurements, geometry, rules, and authorization.
invariants: Jev selects or scores only code-supplied labels and identifiers.
Geometry, measurements, rule thresholds, legal conclusions, and physical edits remain deterministic.
Malformed, incomplete, contradictory, or out-of-range provider responses fail closed.
High-risk or uncertain results are routed to a reasoning model or human instead of being executed.
Tests use a fake transport and do not spend TypeSafe credits.

deep_scan_campaign.objective: Run a bounded adaptive Jev and Astra campaign after a scan is assessed, with one-inch environment physics, all-pairs customer and evacuation routes, and deterministic candidate validation.
invariants: No model may change captured geometry, legal thresholds, fixed fixtures, or owner inventory.
Jev prioritizes and ranks; deterministic geometry and physics decide pass, failure, and improvement.
Astra candidates remain recommendations and are never saved as the measured room automatically.
The result is accessibility and safety screening, not ADA, fire-code, or legal certification.
Every live provider loop has per-scan call and iteration caps.
